notes: Material-only package: the original task conditionally requests runtime checks if a usable historical binary can be obtained. Material validation does not grant analyzer execution or proof-replay qualification.

Official source and licenses are retained unchanged. The full distribution includes non-commercial CompCert components; Verasco-specific sources have the stated dual GPL/non-commercial licensing, and polyhedral components carry their own notices.
The soundness statement is no alarms implies no modeled run-time errors. Alarms may be conservative; the material is not a completeness guarantee or a proof about arbitrary ISO C/C++.
The historical prototype does not establish unrestricted recursion/dynamic-allocation support. Its specified CompCert language subset and external-function assumptions remain relevant.
A local Coq 8.4pl4/OCaml 4.01/Menhir 20160808 preflight passed. The proof build was paused during memory contention; it is not counted as a completed proof or analyzer execution.
